phase3-uncovered-axes.name: CHAOS-3219 Phase 3: epic-named axes with a realized fixture but no case
phase3-uncovered-axes.$comment: Three ids for axes the epic names explicitly and no case covered. measured-zero (group 9) had a purpose-built sources.json fixture -- probe/source-measured-zero, an explicit DORAMetricsRecord value=0.0 -- whose only prior appearances were incidental authorized_entity_ids lists; deg.source-state.no-data's own profile note already recorded it as 'not realized in this batch'. The epic's group-8 bullet names 'malicious Markdown/HTML/links' and only markdown and links existed. The epic names person-level health/workload/productivity as three axes and only workload had a case. Additive: the frozen 'groups' block above is untouched. 'groups' here is documentation of which corpus groups these ids belong to; the loader reads only 'ids'.

totals_after_amendment.$comment_phase3: PIN MOVED DELIBERATELY, CHAOS-3219 Phase 3 (2026-08-07): ids 143 -> 146.
